keep.reason: It renders a normal Three scene into Three-owned color and depth targets, then applies atmosphere in a fullscreen ShaderMaterial pass in the same renderer context.
The same config object drives Three light selection and shader uniforms for distant/spherical and flat/local scenarios.
It provides deterministic CPU comparison for live pass validation without making scene packets part of the normal render path.

rewrite.reason: Move lab inline shader strings into shared production shader modules with stable uniform structs and compile-time feature gates.
Keep the control concepts, but wire production UI to app-owned source, geometry, atmosphere, and display state.
Promote only the useful debug views and numeric checks; leave artifact bookkeeping in the lab.

discard.reason: Packets remain validation/oracle artifacts, not the production render input.
The target integration is a Three pass over a live Three scene.
The accepted POC path colors the final camera view from scene color and depth.

sourceAdapters: flat-local-point-sun -> PointLight or explicit local light adapter + finite-source shader uniforms
geometryAdapters: spherical-atmosphere-geometry -> top-atmosphere ray length and world/camera conversion
flat-z-up-atmosphere -> configured top altitude and sky ray limit
